values.note: $29 a night for an RV: the $22 campsite fee plus the $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (tent campers pay $22), plus tax and a $6.70 nonrefundable reservation fee. No out-of-state rate; Florida residents 65 and over (or with a qualifying disability award) get half off the base campsite fee. Park entry $5 per vehicle. The park's Hours & Fees page, read 2026-10-21.

values.note: 30 campsites, 12 of them equestrian-designated with tie-outs near the barn (booked as Loop LLL). On Reserve Florida the 17 family sites take rigs to 55 ft, 9 of them pull-through.

values.note: Restrooms with solar-heated showers; two picnic pavilions in the campground. Campers arriving after sunset call the park for the gate combination; set up by 11 p.m.
